method: Direct language-model editorial merge in the coding session; no external API calls; source categories retained.

original_descriptions: Not using dried and cleaned measuring spoons (might contaminate the ingredients)
Use cheddar cheese instead of mozzarella cheese
merges.merged_description: Used measuring spoons that were not clean and dry, risking ingredient contamination, and used cheddar cheese instead of mozzarella cheese.
